segments.name: oncology therapeutics
segments.description: Clinical-stage oncology company developing in-licensed antibody drug conjugates against tumor targets for patients with difficult-to-treat cancers.
segments.evidence: The Company has identified its Chief Executive Officer as the chief operating decision maker and the Company views its operations and manages its business in one operating segment

revenueModel.text: Revenue came from sales of FYARRO, the company's only product, which was divested in 2025; the company now funds development of its ADC Therapies with no approved product.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company's revenues relate to sales of FYARRO, which was divested as of March 25, 2025.

changes.text: In 2025 the company divested its FYARRO Business to KAKEN and no longer operates it.
changes.evidence: The divestiture transaction closed on March 25, 2025 and, as a result, we no longer operate the FYARRO Business.

changes.text: In 2024 the company in-licensed three ADC assets and transitioned to a new pipeline with different targets and indications.
changes.evidence: Through the License Agreement, we have transitioned to a new pipeline and are pursuing different targets and indications from those we have historically pursued, which has risks.
